how: A member asks others to join a fresh green box at specified coordinates without establishing their uptake.
The rebuilding proposer meets the revised starter definition without needing evidence that anyone joined.
A moderator explains postponing lettering by insufficient conquered space and manpower.
The room borrows lattice expansion while keeping green-only pixels and a single solid Box as its stated goal.
A participant reports a north-east frame being built while also urging work in the bottom left.
Members correct mistaken directions and supply a newcomer with the new location and an expansion coordinate.
Three separate accounts explain additional placement capacity rather than appointment to leadership.
A reply assents to expansion before conquest without asking for anything back.
A proposed vote and claimed temporary leader place the room within the claim's decided-order minority despite descriptions of informal coordination.
Live-chat invitations and a request for real-time communication precede a public report of temporary Discord leadership.
A participant presents devotion to the Box as a sacrifice of their morning without specifying elapsed placement time.
Calls explicitly defend the Box and Core while the added mechanism of uninformed keepers reversing planned changes remains untested.
A participant explains apparent off-colour work as temporary covering and reports personally having used that tactic.
Participants ask for a smiley to survive, forbid greening art and ask invading blues to spare a memorial.
A neighbouring representative offers peace without a recorded acceptance in the cited concept.
The peace proposal is carried by a speaker presenting themself as a diplomat for another corner.
A lattice pledge receives acceptance while other speakers urge combined effort and recruit greens into the Lattice.
Cooperation can retain a distinct final design and exclude a neighbouring shade rather than merge all allied goals.
A move toward quieter ground and a later choice between saving the corner and starting elsewhere make relocation a visible option.
A new-coordinate recruitment call supports a proposed restart but does not demonstrate successful rebuilding.
Relocation is made usable through correcting directional errors, spreading the correction and answering requests with coordinates.
Treat moving as collective cessation only where that is established, because relocation advocacy here coexists with continued support for parallel positions.
Early advice concentrates work in the original box and expands outward before the record's later relocation episode.
Praise, teaching, repeated green allegiance and sacrifice make colour faith an explicit part of the room's conduct.
Members extend the colour's rule into the subreddit itself by demanding green CSS.
Ally-or-heretic language makes colour allegiance an explicit criterion in evaluating cooperation without establishing that it caused an alliance.
Calling blues closet green supporters makes a new joke out of neighbouring colour factions.
A live chat gathers a named canvas faction whose members share green devotion without establishing when the subreddit itself formed.
A report of blue desecrating sacred green records the work's adverse fate during placing.
The post-close invitation proposes recreating the Box on another canvas without demonstrating participation or reconstruction.
Calls propose taking a corner, converting Hogwarts into Slytherin and striking back against attackers.
The infiltration proposal separates green placement from using words to turn rival colour factions against each other without showing implementation.
Reaching rivals can aim to incite conflict between two opponents so they overlook the room rather than collect their plans.
Joint-fight appeals and coalition recruitment leave delivered pixels and reciprocal help unobserved.
A plea to spare a smiley does not establish another room living on acknowledged host territory under its rules.
Informal coordination and a temporary-leader claim do not state limits on committing placers to an inter-room agreement.
The coded post-close invitation concerns another canvas rather than a dispute over preserving or cleaning the event's historical record.
Event-period colour enemies do not establish a quarrel predating the canvas.
Colour antagonism and a Hogwarts conversion proposal leave the pre-canvas origin required by the claim unresolved.
A green CSS demand and devotional praise do not establish that an April Fools host prank licensed false canvas claims.
Internal chat recruitment and green CSS demands do not establish a posting boundary around canvas talk.
The coded sacrifice and construction report do not establish completion celebration or credit for a finished work.
A proposal to incite two opponents does not show delivered taunts or a continuing verbal contest with either rival.
Giving a newcomer a location does not establish explanation of canvas rules or controls.
The prediction that visible expansion will attract others does not establish actual arrivals through the mark.
The art-preservation command does not show an objection to offensive speech or hate symbols.
An invitation to rebuild and generic recruitment do not establish outreach to creators, companies or the press.
The coded plea and prohibition show restraint without a recorded argument over the fairness of covering work.
A sacrifice of a morning and informal coordination do not establish stress-driven withdrawal or repair of an interpersonal quarrel.
Demands for green CSS do not show hostility to canvas posts producing attacks on the room's own mark.
Spare accounts explain extra placement capacity without a reported site malfunction or tested glitch.
The joke that blues secretly support green does not establish actual dual membership or a member torn between rooms.
The recruitment call and separate construction report do not link the called helpers to the reported building.
A single turn both proposing and recruiting does not establish a distinct call following the start.
A defence call and a separate construction report do not establish a linked building-to-upkeep episode.
Defence and a later peace proposal are not linked as pressure from neighbours producing negotiation.
The peace proposal and separate art-restraint instructions do not establish restraint produced by a settled border.
Defence and spare accounts coexist without a passage attributing account multiplication to upkeep strain.
The construction report contains no linked coded celebration prompted by completion.
The coded damage report does not establish celebration prompting preservation.
The successor-canvas invitation does not attribute continuation to preserving a record of the work.
Design preferences and coordinates do not establish a pixel template settling a design argument.
The bare assent answers a tactical proposal rather than a recruitment call, leaving the specified call-to-join mechanism untested.
Scarcity and a joint-fight appeal do not establish outside rooms sending help in response to upkeep pressure.
The peace proposal does not establish a resulting exchange of help or protection.
Recruitment language and attack proposals do not establish that the former brought participants who then turned to attacking.
Attack proposals and art-restraint instructions occur in different threads without a coded refusal answering the particular attack call.
The attack proposal and separate peace offer do not establish negotiation answering that attack.
The proposed infiltration tactic does not establish an attack followed by an implemented verbal contest.
Alliance acceptance and a common-enemy appeal do not establish enacted mutual defence of the allied works.
Chat recruitment and a CSS demand do not establish a canvas-post flood causing a host posting boundary.
A peace proposal and a separate leadership claim leave agreement-triggered limits on binding authority untested even under the revised bound.
